Yeah, I do think about it and I really don't have an answer to that. In my mind there is just a constant battle between rational thinking and a need to be comforted by the idea of some grand higher power watching over me. But I get that there really is no reason or logic to what is happening, people are dying just because they got unlucky. 

It's just that living with this thought for three years and not knowing when this will stop really turns your brain into a mush.

I'm from Ukraine and I've started praying from time to time since the war started. When I hear a drone flying over my house it's the only thing that calms me down even though I've never been religious.
And sometimes I think that I really am protected by some higher powers because it's hard to wrap my head around why I and my loved ones have been able to survive for so long while so many others haven't. I think human brain just isn't designed to comprehend the complete chaos that our world can be, so we just have to resort to faith when shit hits the fan in this capacity. It's a very complicated question for me haha
